tagline: It is by Mary that He has to reign in the world.

spine.note: A constructed cycle through Faber's 1863 English of True Devotion to the Blessed Virgin. Not a 33-day consecration program.

sourceNote: A Treatise on the True Devotion to the Blessed Virgin, translated by Frederick William Faber, D.D. (Burns & Lambert, London, 1863; second edition). Not a modern Montfort translation.
